bullets.text: US Firms Sue Ofcom - US companies challenge UK regulator's enforcement of the Online Safety Act, citing free speech violations.
AI Pilots' High Failure Rate - A staggering 95% of enterprise generative AI projects fail, highlighting the need for better strategies.
AI Chip Market Boom - Omdia forecasts AI chip market to reach $286 billion by 2030, despite slowing growth rates.
Nvidia Eyes China Market - Nvidia's CEO hints at potential sales of Blackwell AI chips in China, pending US regulations.
Edge Computing Challenges - Telecoms must address thermal and power efficiency for AI deployments at edge locations.
Data Center Workforce Crisis - The construction industry faces a shortage of skilled tradespeople, slowing data center builds.
China's Satellite Internet Push - China accelerates development of low-orbit satellite internet to compete with **Starlink**.
AI Reshapes Banking Jobs - Generative AI could displace 27,000 UK banking jobs by 2030, prompting reskilling initiatives.
South Africa's Fibre Network Consolidation - Efforts underway to streamline public fibre networks for better connectivity.
SK Telecom Fined $97M - South Korea's SK Telecom faces record fine for data breach affecting millions of customers.
